model.initialization: fresh complete cached ImageNet encoder, including conv_head and norm_head; new scalar point
model.spatial_order: channel-major, row-major2x2 within each semantic channel

source.roll_validation_split: independent layout/seed/ID/group; same available HDR background
source.population_policy: same four manifest rows and order as retained V22 source; authoritative RGB512 input contract

config.checkpoint_selection: earliest strict minimum R=(original1506 mean NMAE + roll512 mean NMAE + original1506 worst10percent NMAE + roll512 worst10percent NMAE)/4; each worst tail uses ceil(.1*N), including failed inputs/scalars at error1
config.external_checkpoint: source-selected best only after source stopping rule completes
config.inference_input: provided native ROI RGB, linear resize512, ImageNet normalization; one RGB forward, no GT geometry or target scalar input

runtime.full_process_boundary: module entry before torch import through saved predictions; excludes final completion JSON
runtime.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

model_inputs: provided native ROI RGB, linear resize512, ImageNet normalization; one RGB forward, no GT geometry or target scalar input
target_source: offline target derived from four annotated points
development_scope: previously viewed external development; no target training, BN adaptation or selection
failure_policy: retain every declared input; input or scalar failure receives normalized error1
